login.title: Log in to Albert Heijn
login.description:
You log in on **AH's own page** (password and 6-digit code). Home Assistant never sees your password.

1. On a computer, **first open your browser's developer tools** (F12, or ⌥⌘I on a Mac) on the **Console** tab.
2. In that same tab, open the [AH login page]({login_url}).
3. Log in and enter the 6-digit code.
4. The page then tries to open `appie://login-exit?code=…`. That fails, but the console shows that line (Safari and Firefox: **Network** tab, last request). Copy it and paste it below. Just the code also works.

The code expires quickly: paste it within a minute.

💡 Easier with the Mac app: menu **Kansjes › Code voor Home Assistant…**
